fields.Name: IT151 - Encrypted Field Read over GraphQL
fields.Description: MJ: Credentials.Values is encrypted at rest with AllowDecryptInAPI on. ER1 Load over GraphQL returns plaintext; ER2 a first RunView returns plaintext; ER3 a repeated RunView (server cache hit) returns plaintext; ER4 an update of a plain field keeps the encrypted value intact. Mutating; self-cleaning.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: A wire caller always receives the decrypted value, including from the server cache, and unrelated updates do not disturb it.
